_about: Public-domain Henry Jones Ripley (1798-1875), Baptist professor at Newton Theological Institution, for the Word Hoard: his explanatory notes on the Four Gospels, Acts, Romans and Hebrews, Sacred Rhetoric, Church Polity, Christian Baptism (his answer to Moses Stuart), and an ordination sermon. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 136 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ripley-ministers-work: Characteristics of the minister's works : A sermon, preached October 22, 1828, at the ordination of Mr. Calvin Newton as pastor of the Baptist Church and Society in Bellingham, Mass (Boston : Printed by William R. Collier ..., 1828)
ripley-christian-baptism: Christian baptism : an examination of professor Stuart's essay in the Biblical repository, April, 1833, on "The mode of baptism" (Boston : Lincoln, Edmands, 1833)
ripley-acts: The Acts of the apostles (Boston, Gould, Kendall, and Lincoln, 1844)
ripley-sacred-rhetoric: Sacred rhetoric : or, Composition and delivery of sermons (Boston : Gould and Lincoln ; New York : Sheldon, Blakeman ; Cincinnati : Geo. S. Blanchard, 1849)
ripley-four-gospels: The four Gospels : with notes, chiefly explanatory : designed for teachers in Sabbath schools and Bible classes, and as an aid to family instruction (Boston : Gould and Lincoln, 1851)
ripley-romans: The Epistle of the Apostle Paul to the Romans : with notes, chiefly explanatory, designed as an accompaniment to the author's notes on the Gospels and the Acts (Boston : Gould and Lincoln, 1859)
ripley-church-polity: Church polity : a treatise on Christian churches and the Christian ministry (Boston : Graves & Young, 1867)
ripley-hebrews: The Epistle to the Hebrews, with explanatory notes : to which are added a condensed view of the priesthood of Christ and a translation of the Epistle, prepared for this work (Boston : Gould and Lincoln, 1868)

_excluded.ripley-others: Campbell's Lectures on Systematic Theology are Campbell's; the 1875 Tribute is about him
